note: Interface shell of the game: window labels, top bar, state view, hints and confirmation texts (docs/specs/07_interface/05_text_sweep.md family core). This file holds the general keys; core.military.json holds hosts, fleets and wings, core.supply.json holds supply, roads, Stored Essence and the resource descriptions. Every text keeps the placeholders and colour codes of the key it replaces; the sweep refuses a row that loses one.

lit.CLOUDSAVE_UNSYNC_LABEL:
Select the games to remove from the cloud.
Their files stay on this machine.
lit.DIPLOMACY_CREATE_FACTION_NOT_RULE: You cannot found a {faction} without the {national_spirit} that allows it.

lit.FE_HISTORICAL_TOOLTIP: Realms the game plays will, where they can, choose their §HFocuses§! in the order of the old chronicle. Choose this if you want other realms to follow their histories more closely.
lit.FE_IRONMAN_NOPOPS_TOOLTIP: The {ironman} needs a signed-in online account.
lit.FOCUS_FILTER_TOOLTIP:
§HFilters for the {focus_tree}§!

§GClick§! to open or close the filter menu.

Once a filter is chosen, press £tab£ to step through the matching focuses.
lit.FOCUS_SEARCH_TOOLTIP:
§HSearch the {focus_tree} §!

Type a word to search the names and descriptions of focuses.

£tab : Step through the matches.
£RETURN : Open the details of the chosen focus.
